CalculationRecord.title: CalculationRecord
CalculationRecord.description: A mathematical or scientific calculation entry with AES-256-GCM encrypted payload support and workspace association.

workspaceId.description: ID of the calculation workspace window.

title.description: Short label or note for the calculation.

encryptedPayload.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted JSON payload for zero-knowledge privacy.

isPinned.description: Whether this calculation is pinned to the top of history.

category.description: Category tag such as STANDARD, SCIENTIFIC, MATRIX, UNIT, AI_SOLVER.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

WorkspaceWindow.title: WorkspaceWindow
WorkspaceWindow.description: An independent calculation window allowing multi-window parallel calculations synced in real time.

name.description: Display title of the calculation window (e.g., Physics Lab, Tax Budget).

currentExpression.description: Active input expression in this window.

currentResult.description: Live evaluated result in this window.

memoryValue.description: Stored memory register value (M+/M-/MR) as string.

angleMode.description: Trigonometric angle mode for this workspace.

accentColorHex.description: Hex color code for visual identification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CloudBackupVault.title: CloudBackupVault
CloudBackupVault.description: Encrypted backup snapshot of user workspaces, history, and preferences for cloud restore and Google Drive/Dropbox integration.

providerTag.description: Target cloud provider label (FIREBASE_CLOUD, GOOGLE_DRIVE, DROPBOX).

checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 integrity hash of the backup payload.

itemCount.description: Total number of records stored in this backup.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/calculations/{calcId}.description: Per-user calculation history records with encrypted payloads.

/users/{userId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Per-user multiple calculation windows synced in real time.
